motion.name: hud-swap
motion.purpose: Title, description and chip rising in when the material changes.

motion.name: chill-fade
motion.purpose: UI fading out in Chill mode.

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Mix, Chill and camera controls: frosted glass capsule.
components.css: .ds-pill { padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18); background: rgb(14 14 20 / 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); color: #f2f2f7; font: 500 0.8rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Arrow Button
components.css: .ds-arrow { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: #f2f2f7; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-arrow:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); } .ds-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pagination Dots
components.description: Carousel position; the active dot stretches.
components.css: .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; } .ds-dot { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3); transition: width 0.3s, background 0.3s; } .ds-dot.active { width: 1.6rem; background: #fff; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Material family tag with a colored dot.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: #f2f2f7; font: 500 0.7rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff9bb0; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Mix popover with selectable list item.
components.html: Mix with
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 15rem; padding: 0.9rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); background: rgb(14 14 20 / 0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); color: #f2f2f7; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2rem; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 0.6rem; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-item { text-align: left; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-item:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-item.active { border-color: #9fd4ff; background: rgb(159 212 255 / 0.14); }

narrative.overview: The page is a dark stage with one lit subject, the blob. Everything else is instrument glass floating over it: translucent, blurred, hairline-edged controls you can read through. The stage color follows the active material. Confirmed direction for controls: tactile and confident, with soft material-tinted glows as the depth language (not yet built).
keyCharacteristics: Dark, per-material tinted stage; the canvas is transparent.
Translucent glass surfaces with backdrop blur and a 1px white hairline.
One cool accent (ice blue) for interaction.
System sans only; hierarchy from size, weight and tracking.
Chill mode removes everything except the blob and the breathing guide.

rules.name: The Stage Follows The Material Rule
rules.body: The page background is always the current material's background; UI surfaces are translucent so they inherit it.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Ice blue is the only interactive accent.

rules.name: The Tracking Is The Voice Rule
rules.body: Wide letter-spacing on small caps labels and the brand; tight spacing on the large title. No display typeface.

rules.name: The Glass, Not Card Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are translucent with blur and a hairline. Never opaque cards, never hard drop shadows.

rules.name: The Glow Is Tinted Rule
rules.body: Any glow takes its hue from the current material.

dos: Do let the page background follow the active material's background, and keep UI surfaces translucent so they inherit it.
Do use ice blue (#9fd4ff) as the single interaction accent.
Do build glass surfaces with blur (8 to 14px), a 1px white hairline at 0.1 to 0.2 alpha, and ink (#f2f2f7) text.
Do keep full pills for buttons and 12px for panels; give every control a 2px white focus-visible outline.
Do keep the UI quiet enough that the blob stays the brightest thing on screen, and fade everything in Chill mode.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and safe-area insets on every new element.
donts: Don't put a solid opaque card or a hard drop shadow behind controls.
Don't add a second accent color or a decorative typeface.
Don't use pure white text on large areas; keep ink at #f2f2f7 with opacity for secondary text.
Don't hard-code a page background; it comes from the material.
Don't let any control grow large enough to compete with the blob.
